message.title: PitLog v1.6.5 Released 🚀
message.body:
What's new in v1.6.5:

📒 Playbooks — major improvements: rule categories, per-rule analytics (win rate & P&L when followed vs skipped), discipline impact score, and a full Rules Compliance card in Analytics
📦 Backup now includes your screenshots — restore brings them back too
📄 Monthly PDF report: 4 new sections (Performance by Session, Hold Time, Top Trades, Rules Compliance)
📤 Export trades to CSV directly from the Trade Log
🏢 Prop Firm tab: challenges and presets now save and display correctly

🔧 Import fixed for cTrader, Thinkorswim and Tastytrade
💰 Day Commission adjustment fixed

To download v1.6.5, use the personal link from your original Payhip purchase email.
